profile.title: Profile
profile.previewHint: Your display name and user tag appear with your content and in your campaigns.
profile.displayNameHint: This is how the others see you in your campaigns.
profile.userTagHint: Others find you by it, for example for invitations. It can't be changed.
profile.timezoneHint: For dates and times in the app.

email.title: Email address
email.requested: We sent a code to {email}. Your current address stays valid until you confirm.
email.codeInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one if needed.
email.same: This is already your current address.

password.title: Password
password.hint: At least {min} characters. You'll be signed out everywhere afterwards, here too.
password.none: Your account has no password: you sign in through a provider.

methods.title: Sign-in methods
methods.hint: Providers can't be linked later. An address always belongs to exactly one account.

devices.title: Trusted devices
devices.hint: A trusted device still needs your password, but isn't locked out when someone else guesses at your password. Only on your own devices.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.hint: A signed-out device loses access shortly afterwards.
